instructions_to_main_agent: FORCE DARK MODE: The app should default to dark mode. Use 'dark' class on the html/body tag.
USE SHADCN components for all interactive elements (forms, dialogs, dropdowns).
CUSTOMIZE SHADCN: Override default rounded-md to rounded-sm or rounded-none for a sharper, financial look.
NAVIGATION: Use a sticky top nav with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md).
CHARTS: Use Recharts for the P/L and Trade Analysis visualization.
DATA FORMATTING: All currency must be formatted as $0,0.00. All dates as 'DD MMM YYYY'.
TRADE POSTING FORM: This is complex. Break it into steps or clear sections: 1. Pair/Asset, 2. Entry/Exit/SL, 3. Analysis/Strategy, 4. Screenshots.
ECONOMIC CALENDAR: Create a clean table layout. Columns: Time, Currency, Event, Impact (High/Med/Low), Previous, Forecast, Actual.
LECTURES: Use a grid layout for video thumbnails. Detail page should focus on the video player.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text legibility, use solid high-contrast colors.
Every interactive element must have a hover state.
Use data-testid for all key elements.
Ensure mobile responsiveness for the trade posting form is top-tier (traders use phones).
